answers.evidence:
All tests pass on Go 1.26.0 (linux/amd64):

| Test | Status | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| `TestTickerStopPreventsLeak` | ✅ | Verifies ticker.Stop() stops ticks and goroutine cleanup works |
| `TestTickVsNewTicker` | ✅ | Demonstrates Tick() creates unstoppable ticker (anti-pattern) |
| `TestContextCancellationStopsGoroutine` | ✅ | Context cancellation terminates ticker goroutine |
| `TestTickerResetCorrectness` | ✅ | Ticker.Reset() correctly changes interval |
| `TestTickerNonPositiveDuration` | ✅ | NewTicker(0) panics as expected |
| `TestTickReturnsNil` | ✅ | Tick(-1) and Tick(0) return nil |
| `TestTickerConcurrentReadSafety` | ✅ | Multiple goroutines safely read from ticker channel |
| `TestTickerRapidCreateStop` | ✅ | 1000 create/stop cycles, no memory issues |
| `TestHeartbeatFix` | ✅ | Correct heartbeat: 10 ticks in 100ms (10ms interval) |
| `TestGoroutineLeak` | ✅ | Zero leak: runtime.NumGoroutine() delta=0 after 10 concurrent loops |

**Edge cases tested:** zero/negative duration, rapid create/stop (1000 cycles), concurrent readers (5 goroutines), context cancellation, Reset correctness, post-Stop behavior, goroutine leak detection.
